final: SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(ma.player_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award ma2 JOIN player p2 ON p2.player_id = ma2.player_id) AS frac FROM player p LEFT JOIN manager_award ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id ORDER BY frac DESC, p.player_id LIMIT 10
